readings.why: With only the partial word 'invo' typed in the search box above the queue, the list has already narrowed from 7 tickets to the single matching TQ-101 with no search button pressed or even present.

The caption at beat-06 asserts that part of a requester's name finds that person's tickets, but every query actually typed ('invoice', 'webhook') is a title word and no frame ever shows a name or address fragment being searched, so only the caption text claims this clause.
